assessment_policy.rule: Building the book artifacts does not certify a reader. A reader passes only by producing and defending the named evidence in an authorized environment.

domains.capability: Identify the exact PostgreSQL and Pigsty context and turn interactive work into reproducible evidence.
domains.assessment: Given an unfamiliar service endpoint, produce an identity snapshot, object map and rerunnable task with failure-safe output.

domains.capability: Design logical models, types and constraints that encode business truth without hiding lifecycle semantics.
domains.assessment: Defend a schema against invalid, concurrent and evolving input using database and application evidence.

domains.capability: Reason about MVCC, transaction boundaries, functions, triggers and server-side behavior.
domains.assessment: Explain visibility and side effects for a concurrent workflow, then prove rollback and retry behavior.

domains.capability: Diagnose query plans and statistics, design indexes and improve slow SQL from measured evidence.
domains.assessment: Reproduce a regression, explain plan choice, change one hypothesis and compare resource-normalized results.

domains.capability: Control locks, isolation, schema evolution, release compatibility and application database contracts.
domains.assessment: Ship a backwards-compatible change under concurrent load with bounded locks, rollback and contract tests.

domains.capability: Evaluate extensions and specialized search, geospatial, temporal, analytical and distributed workloads.
domains.assessment: Select or reject an extension from workload semantics, operational lifecycle, failure modes and exit strategy.

domains.capability: Deploy, route, pool, protect, back up and recover a PostgreSQL service through Pigsty and native evidence.
domains.assessment: Build a service baseline, prove endpoint semantics, perform an isolated recovery and restore declared state.

domains.capability: Operate authentication, authorization, security, SLO, SOP and observability as explicit contracts.
domains.assessment: Trace one user journey from SLI to PostgreSQL evidence while proving least privilege and escalation policy.

domains.capability: Benchmark responsibly, tune configuration and manage vacuum, freeze and bloat with safety margins.
domains.assessment: Produce a reproducible capacity envelope and maintenance plan that states uncertainty and stop conditions.

domains.capability: Plan logical migration and version upgrade with compatibility, cutover, rollback and validation evidence.
domains.assessment: Rehearse an upgrade or migration candidate, reconcile data and prove the old path remains recoverable.

domains.capability: Protect evidence, classify impact and execute the correct PITR, failover, pressure-relief or rescue route.
domains.assessment: Classify a blind scenario, preserve authority and evidence, recover on the right source and validate business truth.

domains.capability: Convert incident evidence into verified controls, roadmap decisions and safer platform defaults.
domains.assessment: Defend a blameless causal analysis and close one control with independent effectiveness evidence.
